blocks.text: Veteran theater actress-singer May Bayot-De Castro passed away after battling primary myelofibrosis, her sister Lani Misalucha confirmed. The Asia’s Nightingale paid tribute to May through her Facebook page on Monday, Oct. 26. “Some walk beside us for years. Others leave sooner than we’re ready for. But every person we love leaves a little light behind,” she wrote. “I love you Ate.” In September, May and another sister, Karlyn, set up a fundraising campaign for the stage veteran, baring her “incredibly difficult fight” with myelofibrosis.
